name_reason: Compliant with data_fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> convention: data_fd2_battle_ prefix (battle core runtime state), summon_spell_anim_phase describes purpose, _byte reflects the uint8 storage. No Ghidra address residue (no hex suffix). Matches live Ghidra symbol and src declaration byte-identical.
purpose: Animation phase / current sprite frame index of the generic single-target summon-spell animation; a single uint8 of zero-bss runtime scratch driven by the state machine fd2_tick_summon_spell_animation_state.
logic_summary: Owned solely by fd2_tick_summon_spell_animation_state (dispatch entry #2). INIT (state 0) clears it; state 3 sets 0x10; state 6 sets 0xA; late-fix paths in states 1/2 snap 0xA->0xF; state 5 ramps and wraps it across 0x10..0x12 (0x11 fires final SFX + done, 0x12 wraps back to 0x10). Passed by address to fd2_tick_sprite_animation_step as the frame index, which the helper increments/advances via the paired tick counter at 0x53F80. All access is byte-wide and unsigned (MOV/MOVZX/INC byte ptr [0x53F7E]).
element_semantics: Single byte = current sprite frame index / animation phase of the generic single-target summon animation. Significant values: 0 (reset), 0xA, 0xF (late-fix snap), 0x10 (hold/loop cap), 0x11 (completion trigger), 0x12 (wrap sentinel -> 0x10).
comment_original_issue: src comment was accurate and concise but omitted the 0xA->0xF late-fix snap write performed in the state-1/2 paths (real writes to this byte at 0x265fa and 0x26667).
